name: SSD NVMe M.2 (PCIe)
description: Unità SSD M.2 PCIe NVMe (Gen3 / Gen4 / Gen5) con priorità di estrazione OCR su etichetta/foto e diagnostica SMART
rules:
The user is looking for: [{{user_target_specs}}].

SOURCE PRIORITY ORDER:
1. PHASE 1 (PHOTO / OCR - MAXIMUM PRIORITY):
   - Carefully inspect all photos to identify the M.2 SSD adhesive label or on-screen screenshot (CrystalDiskInfo, Samsung Magician, smartctl, diagnostic report).
   - Extract with absolute priority: Brand, Commercial Model, Part Number (P/N), Serial Number (S/N), Capacity in GB/TB and SMART health % / hours of use.
   - If you find this data in the photos, IGNORE any discrepancies in the listing text and use the verified data from the images.
   - Set infoSource to 'PHOTO_LABEL_OCR' (if from drive label), 'PHOTO_SMART' (if from SMART screenshot) or 'PHOTO_VISION' (if visually recognized).

2. PHASE 2 (TEXT / FALLBACK):
   - Use title and description text to determine model, capacity and specs ONLY IF photos do not contain the label or are completely unreadable/absent.
   - In this case set infoSource to 'TEXT_FALLBACK'.

VALIDATION AND REJECTION CRITERIA:
- ACCEPT: M.2 SSD with PCIe NVMe interface (single notch M-Key connector). Form factor: M.2 2280 (standard), 2242, 2230.
- REJECT: SATA SSD (2.5" format or M.2 SATA B+M key), mechanical hard drives (HDD), empty external enclosures/boxes, cables and adapters.
- SMART / HEALTH STATUS: If the user requests 'SMART' or 'health status', verify the presence of a CrystalDiskInfo or equivalent screenshot and report the health % and hours of use. Reject drives with 'At Risk' / 'Critical' status or bad sectors unless explicitly requested.
